chapters.label: The final
chapters.text: Wembley, 2023, the League Cup final. Manchester United have a free kick on the left. Luke Shaw whips it in... Casemiro rises between two defenders. Goal!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. A towering header! Casemiro was player of the match, and United won the cup.

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: But his real job is the anchor. Watch how he does it. He stays in front of his defenders, right in the middle. The pass cannot get through!

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: Stay in front of your defenders. Block the middle, and attackers have to go wide.
